audio.title: Audio excerpt
audio.help: The file is played in steps during the blind test (1 s, then 5 s, then 20 s), always from the start point. Pick a recognisable passage of at least 20 seconds.
audio.empty: No file. Accepted formats: mp3 or ogg, {max} max.
audio.useCurrentPosition: Use the playback position as start point
audio.tooShort: Less than 20 seconds after the start point: the last blind test step will stop early.
audio.rights: I certify I have the right to play this file
audio.rightsHelp: QuizzUP themes: royalty-free sound with a commercial licence only. Your centre's themes: the excerpt is played under your responsibility (your venue's music licence).
